turns.input: Captain Doran Hale gives Nicco a pair of leather boots.
turns.narration:
Captain Doran Hale reaches down and lifts a worn pair of leather boots from beside him, extending them toward Nicco. "Here. You'll want something sturdier than what you're wearing if you're going to be walking the tower's steps and Calderan's streets." The boots are scuffed but solid, with thick soles and laces that have been replaced more than once.

He waits for Nicco to take them, his scarred hands steady. The square's moderate daytime traffic passes behind him—ordinary folk going about their business, a few glancing toward the captain's armor without stopping.

Nicco accepts the boots. They hang heavy in his hands, leather still holding the shape of someone else's feet.

turns.input:
Thanks *he said to them, after which he decides to give them back the boots*
You'll need them more than me
turns.narration:
Captain Doran Hale looks down at the boots, then back up at Nicco. "I gave them to you," he says, his voice even. "I have my own." He makes no move to take them back. The square's foot traffic continues around them, a few passers-by glancing at the two men standing before Heartstone's massive entrance.

He keeps his eyes on Nicco, waiting to see what he'll do with the refused return.
